periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards and outwards from the medial to lateral edges.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a high vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering effect, with the lowest point significantly narrowed compared to the upper region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band appears thick, covering approximately 40-50% of the visible torso height at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between ears, which are positioned at the extreme superolateral margins of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Apex exhibits a moderate taper, appearing slightly pointed rather than perfectly semicircular.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow discoloration of the fur on the ventral and chest region compared to the white facial fur.
